sentences.text: Yemen -LRB- -LSB- ˈjɛmən -RSB- اليَمَن -RRB- , officially known as the Republic of Yemen , is an Arab country in Western Asia , occupying South Arabia , the southern end of the Arabian Peninsula .	Arab	Arabs	Western Asia	Western Asia	South Arabia	South Arabia	Arabian Peninsula	Arabian Peninsula
Yemen is the second-largest country in the peninsula , occupying 527,970 km2 -LRB- 203,850 sq mi -RRB- .
The coastline stretches for about 2,000 km -LRB- 1,200 mi -RRB- .

It is bordered by Saudi Arabia to the north , the Red Sea to the west , the Gulf of Aden and Arabian Sea to the south , and Oman to the east-northeast .	Aden	Aden	Saudi Arabia	Saudi Arabia	Red Sea	Red Sea	Gulf of Aden	Gulf of Aden	Arabian Sea	Arabian Sea	Oman	Oman
Although Yemen 's constitutionally stated capital is the city of Sana'a , the city has been under rebel control since February 2015 .	Sana'a	Sana'a	under rebel control	Yemeni Civil War (2015–present)
Because of this , Yemen 's capital has been temporarily relocated to the port city of Aden , on the southern coast .	Aden	Aden
Yemen 's territory includes more than 200 islands ; the largest of these is Socotra .	Socotra	Socotra

Yemen was the home of the Sabaeans -LRB- biblical Sheba -RRB- , a trading state that flourished for over a thousand years and also included parts of modern-day Ethiopia and Eritrea .	Sabaeans	Sabaeans	Sheba	Sheba	Ethiopia	Ethiopia	Eritrea	Eritrea
In 275 AD , the region came under the rule of the later Jewish-influenced Himyarite Kingdom .	Jewish	Yemenite Jews	Himyarite Kingdom	Himyarite Kingdom
Christianity arrived in the fourth century , whereas Judaism and local paganism were already established .	Judaism	Judaism	paganism	paganism
Islam spread quickly in the seventh century and Yemenite troops were crucial in the expansion of the early Islamic conquests .	Islam	Islam
Administration of Yemen has long been notoriously difficult .
Several dynasties emerged from the ninth to 16th centuries , the Rasulid dynasty being the strongest and most prosperous .	Rasulid dynasty	Rasulid dynasty
The country was divided between the Ottoman and British empires in the early twentieth century .	Ottoman	Ottoman Empire	British	British Empire

The Zaydi Mutawakkilite Kingdom of Yemen was established after World War I in North Yemen before the creation of the Yemen Arab Republic in 1962 .	North Yemen	North Yemen	Yemen Arab Republic	Yemen Arab Republic	Arab	Arabs	Zaydi	Zaidiyyah	Mutawakkilite Kingdom of Yemen	Mutawakkilite Kingdom of Yemen	World War I	World War I

South Yemen remained a British protectorate known as the Aden Protectorate until 1967 when it became an independent state and later , a Marxist state .	Aden	Aden	South Yemen	South Yemen	British	British Empire	Aden Protectorate	Aden Protectorate	Marxist	Marxist
The two Yemeni states united to form the modern republic of Yemen in 1990 .	united	Yemeni unification
Yemen is a developing country , and the poorest country in the Middle East .	developing country	developing country
Under the rule of President Ali Abdullah Saleh , Yemen was described as a kleptocracy .	President	President of Yemen	Ali Abdullah Saleh	Ali Abdullah Saleh	kleptocracy	kleptocracy
According to the 2009 international corruption Perception Index by Transparency International , Yemen ranked 164 out of 182 countries surveyed .	Transparency International	Transparency International

In the absence of strong state institutions , elite politics in Yemen constituted a de facto form of collaborative governance , where competing tribal , regional , religious , and political interests agreed to hold themselves in check through tacit acceptance of the balance it produced .	elite politics	Elite theory

The informal political settlement was held together by a power-sharing deal between three men : president Ali Abdullah Saleh , who controlled the state ; Major General Ali Mohsen al-Ahmar , who controlled the largest share of the Republic of Yemen Armed Forces ; and Abdullah ibn Husayn al-Ahmar , figurehead of the Islamist Islah party and Saudi Arabia 's chosen broker of transnational patronage payments to various political players , including tribal sheikhs .	Saudi Arabia	Saudi Arabia	Ali Abdullah Saleh	Ali Abdullah Saleh	Ali Mohsen al-Ahmar	Ali Mohsen al-Ahmar	Republic of Yemen Armed Forces	Republic of Yemen Armed Forces	Abdullah ibn Husayn al-Ahmar	Abdullah ibn Husayn al-Ahmar	Islah party	Al-Islah (Yemen)	patronage payments	clientelism

The Saudi payments have been intended to facilitate the tribes ' autonomy from the Yemeni government and to give the Saudi government a mechanism with which to weigh in on Yemen 's political decision-making .

Yemen has been in a state of political crisis since 2011 , starting with street protests against poverty , unemployment , corruption , and president Saleh 's plan to amend Yemen 's constitution and eliminate the presidential term limit , in effect making him president for life .	political crisis	Yemeni Crisis (2011–present)	street protests	Yemeni Revolution

President Saleh stepped down and the powers of the presidency were transferred to Vice President Abd Rabbuh Mansur Hadi , who was formally elected president on 21 February 2012 in a one-man election .	President	President of Yemen	Abd Rabbuh Mansur Hadi	Abd Rabbuh Mansur Hadi	one-man election	Yemeni presidential election, 2012

The transitional process was disrupted by conflicts between the Houthis and al-Islah , as well as the al-Qaeda insurgency .	Houthis	Houthis	al-Islah	al-Islah (Yemen)	al-Qaeda insurgency	al-Qaeda insurgency in Yemen
In September 2014 , the Houthis took over Sana'a , later declaring themselves in control of the government in a coup d'état .	Sana'a	Sana'a	Houthis	Houthis	coup d'état	coup d'état
Since then , a Saudi-led intervention has taken place , however , it could not stop the civil war .	Saudi-led intervention	Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen

The Saudi-led intervention has caused massive damage to Yemeni infrastructure and has resulted in the bombing of hospitals and funeral processions among other civilian targets .	Saudi-led intervention	Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen
